fieldDescription: Hold this key on the campaign map to open the radial menu at the mouse. Move onto an ability and release the key to use it. To clear a key, click it and press Escape. With all three hotkeys cleared, the menu cannot open. Takes effect when you save. Default: B.
Another key that opens the radial menu, the same way as Hotkey. Default: L-Ctrl.
A third key that opens the radial menu, the same way as Hotkey. Default: R-Ctrl.
How many slots the main wheel shows, from 1 to 10. Slots past this number keep their abilities and come back when you raise it. Takes effect the next time you open the wheel. Default: 7.
How many slots each submenu shows on the outer ring, from 1 to 10. Slots past this number keep their abilities. Default: 5.
Tiles show only their icon, in the middle of the tile. Turn off to show each ability's name above its icon. Empty tiles stay blank while this is on. Default: on.

Every usable tile shows a dim tint of its icon's colour, not only the one under the mouse. The tile under the mouse still lights up brighter. Empty and unusable tiles stay plain. Takes effect the next time you open the wheel. Default: off.

Shows the game's own tooltip for the ability under the mouse beside the wheel, after the usual short hover delay. Press F1 while it shows for more detail. Takes effect the next time you open the wheel. Default: on.

Picks the tile in the mouse's direction from the wheel's center, however far out the mouse is, like a weapon wheel in a shooter. Releasing outside the ring then uses that tile; release in the center or press Escape to cancel. Submenu tiles still need the mouse past the main ring. Takes effect the next time you open the wheel. Default: off.
The tile under the mouse rises out of its ring. Turn off to keep every tile in place. Default: on.
Lifts and submenus appear at once instead of easing in and out, and the glow on active abilities stays steady. Default: off.
